boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Documented no-admission activities and events at Saint Mary’s College.

cards.title: Attend the McMahon Aquinas Lecture
cards.subtitle: Stapleton Lounge, Le Mans Hall
cards.notes: Check the College events calendar for the next symposium session, then bring a friend to a public lecture in Stapleton Lounge.
cards.short_summary: A public theology lecture presented through the McMahon Aquinas Chair.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary’s listed the March 18, 2026 McMahon Aquinas Lecture as free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: The 2026 Symposium of St. Thomas Aquinas
cards.access_notes: The cited event was free and open to the public; confirm future-session details with the College calendar.

cards.title: Hear the Madeleva Lecture
cards.subtitle: Carroll Auditorium, Madeleva Hall
cards.notes: Use the event page to locate the next Madeleva Lecture and attend the public address in Carroll Auditorium with a classmate.
cards.short_summary: A public address in the long-running Madeleva Lecture series.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary’s described the 2026 Madeleva Lecture as free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: The cited event was free and open to the public; livestream registration was offered separately.

cards.entity_name: Preparing for the Dementia Tsunami: Helping People to Care, Cope and Prepare
cards.title: Join a public psychology talk
cards.subtitle: Carroll Auditorium, Madeleva Hall
cards.notes: Watch the College calendar for comparable public talks, then meet up before the program to discuss the speaker’s practical takeaways.
cards.short_summary: A College-hosted public talk on caregiving and dementia.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary’s listed this April 7, 2026 talk as free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Preparing for the Dementia Tsunami: Helping People to Care, Cope and Prepare
cards.access_notes: The cited College talk was free and open to the public; verify dates for future talks.

cards.title: Attend Raise Your Voice programming
cards.subtitle: Stapleton Lounge, Le Mans Hall
cards.notes: Review the symposium schedule before attending, and choose a session that feels useful for a thoughtful conversation with friends afterward.
cards.short_summary: A Saint Mary’s symposium addressing sexual-violence awareness.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary’s listed the April 13, 2026 Raise Your Voice Symposium as free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: The cited symposium was free and open to the public; content may address sexual violence.

cards.title: Watch Dance Performance Finals
cards.subtitle: Little Theatre, Moreau Center for the Arts
cards.notes: Check the Moreau schedule near term’s end, then arrive a little early for a seat at the student dance-performance finals.
cards.short_summary: A public showcase of Saint Mary’s dance performance work.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary’s stated that its 2026 Dance Performance Finals event was free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: The cited 2026 finals were free and open to the public; confirm venue and date for future finals.

cards.title: Catch a String Ensemble concert
cards.subtitle: Stapleton Lounge, Le Mans Hall
cards.notes: Use the Moreau Marquee to find the next String Ensemble date and settle in for an evening concert with no admission charge.
cards.short_summary: A Saint Mary’s String Ensemble performance in Stapleton Lounge.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary’s stated that admission for its listed String Ensemble performance was free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: The cited performance was free and open to the public; confirm future performance details before going.

cards.title: Listen to the Spring Choir Concert
cards.subtitle: Church of Our Lady of Loretto
cards.notes: Look for the spring concert announcement, then gather a few people for a choral program inside the Church of Our Lady of Loretto.
cards.short_summary: A choral concert featuring Saint Mary’s singing groups.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary’s stated that admission for its listed Spring Choir Concert was free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: The cited concert was free and open to the public; confirm the current spring program before attending.

cards.title: Go to a flute and piano recital
cards.subtitle: Stapleton Lounge, Le Mans Hall
cards.notes: Check the Marquee for a recital date, then use the set time to hear faculty or guest musicians in a small campus venue.
cards.short_summary: A Saint Mary’s music recital in Stapleton Lounge.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary’s stated that admission for its listed Flute and Piano Recital was free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: The cited recital was free and open to the public; verify the current recital listing before attending.

cards.entity_name: Anne Lindberg: At the Edge of the Sea
cards.title: View a Moreau Gallery exhibition
cards.subtitle: Moreau Art Galleries, Moreau Center for the Arts
cards.notes: Check the gallery’s current exhibition dates, then spend time looking closely at the work and comparing observations with a friend.
cards.short_summary: A contemporary-art exhibition presented through the Moreau Art Galleries.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary’s described the Moreau Galleries as venues for professional contemporary-art exhibitions and listed Anne Lindberg’s 2026 exhibition there.
cards.access_notes: Saint Mary’s separately states that Moreau Art Gallery events are free and open to the public; confirm the current exhibition’s access details.

cards.entity_name: George and Juanda Bick Nature Area Trail
cards.title: Walk the Bick Nature Area trail
cards.subtitle: George and Juanda Bick Nature Area, adjacent to campus
cards.notes: Follow the two-and-a-half-mile trail at an unhurried pace; bring water, stay on the route, and leave plants and wildlife undisturbed.
cards.short_summary: A trail through Saint Mary’s 100-acre nature area beside campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary’s describes the adjacent George and Juanda Bick Nature Area as a 100-acre area with a two-and-a-half-mile trail for looking, listening, studying, contemplating, and photographing.
cards.access_notes: No admission or purchase requirement is stated on the College’s nature-area page; follow its no-hunting, no-collecting, no-smoking guidance.

warnings: Several cited College event pages document specific 2026 offerings that have already occurred as of the supplied fetch date; verify future dates before visiting.
The Bick Nature Area page documents the trail and permitted enjoyment but does not explicitly state an admission policy.
One card relies on a nature-area page that does not explicitly state a no-admission policy; included only because the College describes the trail as an area for enjoyment.
